AttributionLimits: This follow-up records 187/267 correct positive images versus 188/267 in the previous pass. Previously correct images lost: ['qrcode-3/11.png']; gained: []. Paired negative completion is [30, 31, 30, 30]/31 with the current binary and [30, 30, 30, 30]/31 with the previous qualified binary. All outcomes remain sensitive to shared-host contention and wall-clock budgets; no universal timeout or recognition advantage is established. Data Matrix changes copy work and clears stale success diagnostics, without changing acceptance thresholds or search effort. Supplemental PDF417 images are regression evidence informed by prior remediation, not an unseen holdout. The invalid GS1 AI (3922) oracle and undeclared QR character encoding policies remain unchanged in scoring. Expanded Stacked multiple-symbol localization and arbitrary perspective remain unproved; MaxiCode image scanning is unsupported. The lost QR photograph records DeadlineExceeded in the frozen pass; the unchanged QR source and bounded follow-up remain documented. Both binaries time out in all four cold single-image checks each. These checks do not replace the original frozen outcome or isolate host load from process warmup.

Existing cell geometry, independent image fixtures, border damage, perspective, malformed input and completion/cancellation checks remain.

SupplementalPdf417.Selection: All PNG images with UTF-8 text oracles in pdf417-1, pdf417-2 and pdf417-3, excluding the 18 frozen comparison images. The 38-image selection was fixed before the first supplemental outcomes. One revealed regression informed the final correction and permanent fixture; the final set is supplemental regression evidence, not an unseen holdout.
SupplementalPdf417.Limit: Supplemental images from the same upstream collection, outside the 18 frozen comparison images. The initial check exposed a sampling-priority regression that was repaired and added to permanent tests. This is regression evidence used during remediation, not an unseen holdout for the final candidate, a replacement ranking, or proof on an independent dataset. Wall-clock budgets also limit attribution of changed outcomes.

NegativeCostDiagnostics.Scope: Exploratory direct Data Matrix scans of three negative textures. Two warmups and six measured iterations per image, preloaded pixels, normal priority and CCD0 affinity. Previous host ran before current host; these are sequential shared-host diagnostics, separate from the rotated twelve-sample fair benchmarks.

QrDeadlineProbe.Scope: Bounded alternating current/previous checks on both cache domains after the timing suites, with unchanged 1500 ms robust profile. Each pass starts a fresh process with one image and no warmup; process warmup differs from the complete corpus pass. These diagnostics do not replace the failed frozen-corpus outcome.
